page.title: Launch
page.purpose: Launch in one screen with the desk's defaults: topics, suggested quotes with their source, workstream titles, allowance and models already chosen; each blocking earlier commission with the desk's choice selected and changeable in place; size gates; one Launch button or the manual copy, with no command-line text.

states.description: Prepared packets first (and unknown packets the operator can assert were never started), then the builder: the form kept while the operator looks elsewhere, quotes filled from the newest commission on the chosen topics, the cheaper model pre-selected, and blockers with the recommended choice selected. Three topics with defaults is tick, tick, tick, Launch, Confirm.
A size gate fails: the gate names the largest parts to cut and Launch is disabled.
Automatic launch is unavailable: the same screen ends in the two messages to paste and the folder path.
The confirm dialog names what is superseded or run alongside, the Web Console access in plain words, and where the messages go.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
The page announces that it is reading the research home; nothing is shown as known until it is.
The research home has no topics yet: the page says a topic needs a MISSION.md first.
An optional scenario is down: only the values it feeds read unknown, each with the reason; everything read from files is still shown.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
